text: I had a very negative experience getting a filling at this clinic. I felt completely distrustful during the procedure. It started with the dentist giving an assistant a small X-ray; the first attempt was incomplete. A second assistant did it, but didn't show me the film or explain the situation. They just said the cavity was deep, almost reaching the nerve, and proceeded with the filling. However, during the procedure, the assistant didn't properly suction my saliva, and something happened – I was shocked and scared. About five days later, I experienced strange pain and sensitivity, so I went back to the dentist to have my bite adjusted. The dentist explained that pain is normal due to the proximity to the nerve and would last about two weeks. I understood this, and the dentist adjusted my bite, but I asked to see the X-ray. They insisted they had already shown me and explained it, but I didn't want to argue, so I asked for a second explanation. Most importantly, I believe dental clinics should prioritize cleanliness and sterilization. During my treatment, the clinic door was left wide open, allowing people waiting outside to see everything. I felt unsure about the hygiene standards. I'm completely put off by this clinic.
